name: Snowdrift Input
description: A pill search field with rotating placeholders whose text blows away like drifting snow when submitted.

props.name: placeholders
props.description: Placeholders shown in turn while the field is empty. Each slides up and out as the next slides in.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the text on every change, and with an empty string after a submit.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the text when the form is submitted. The text then turns to drifting grains and the field empties.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the round submit button.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the field. Defaults to the placeholder shown. Prefer aria-labelledby when there is a visible label.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of the element that labels the field.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the input, for form data.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Turns the field off and dims it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the pill, which is a form element. Other props go to the form.
